description: This Java class defines a response object for a 'DeleteFeatureProperty' command within a larger IoT or device management framework. It encapsulates details about the deletion of a property within a feature of a Thing, including IDs, JSON pointers, and headers. The class supports creating instances from JSON, generating JSON payloads, and handling equality and string representation.

classes.name: DeleteFeaturePropertyResponse
classes.description: A response object representing the outcome of a DeleteFeatureProperty command, including serialization/deserialization and utility methods.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of DeleteFeaturePropertyResponse with given parameters, now typed with ThingId.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string or object into an instance of DeleteFeaturePropertyResponse.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Thing associated with this response.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the feature whose property was deleted.

methods.name: getPropertyPointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer indicating the property that was deleted.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new response instance with updated headers.
